    Long morphisms #

    A nonzero morphism μ is maximal if μ ≤ ν (that is ν = α ≫ μ ≫ β) with ν ≠ 0 forces ν ≤ μ; a long morphism is a maximal morphism that is not irreducible (Bongartz, Indecomposables live in all smaller lengths, Section 2.1). The order is antisymmetric (RayCat.le_antisymm), so a nonzero morphism factoring through a maximal μ is μ itself (RayCat.isLongAt_of_maximal).

    ∃ (h : x = y), f = CategoryTheory.eqToHom h

    An isomorphism of a ray category is an equality of objects with the identity.

    ∃ (hx : x = a) (hy : y = b), f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom hx) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp μ (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯))

    A nonzero morphism factoring through a maximal morphism is that morphism.
